rationale: With only 26 minutes to close, NVDA is drifting lower in a tight range (last 5 candles show a gradual decline from ~162.48 to ~162.09) below the 9-EMA ($162.53) and near VWAP ($161.77), with no clear directional momentum to exploit. The mechanical setup lacks a clean catalyst or structure to justify committing capital.
